Label: path-selection,spike
Summary: Decide preferred source path (Databricks vs SAP)
Description: Run a short technical and access assessment to confirm SAP as the selected integration path.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision documented and approved by business + IT with SAP selected.

Label: filtering,subscriptions
Description: Ensure each subscription receives only its authorized customer data slice.
Acceptance Criteria: Filtering uses subscription attributes; no cross-customer leakage; validated with at least 2 sample subscriptions.

Label: ops,reliability
Description: Make daily run resilient with clear logging, retry behavior, and run-level status visibility.
Acceptance Criteria: Scheduled run executes daily; per-subscription failures are logged; retries configurable; success/failure traceable.

Label: testing,uat
Summary: Create validation suite and UAT checklist
Description: Build repeatable validation to compare output against source and support business sign-off.
Acceptance Criteria: Test cases cover mapping, filtering, and delivery; UAT checklist completed and signed off by business owner.

Label: adapter,sap
Summary: Implement real data adapter for SAP
Description: Create adapter to pull PO status data from SAP interface and normalize to report schema.
Acceptance Criteria: Adapter authenticates, retrieves scoped data, maps required fields, handles retries/timeouts, logs failures.

Label: go-live,cutover
Description: Deploy selected adapter path and complete controlled go-live for NA/USA subscriptions.
Acceptance Criteria: Selected path live; first 5 daily runs successful; rollback plan documented; support handoff completed.
